subject.title: fix(discord): limit implicit reply references to first chunk

question: Should this source-aware PR be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99068 instead of the other open Discord reply-fanout PRs?
rationale: Multiple contributor PRs target the same message-delivery bug, and merging more than one would duplicate or conflict in the Discord send layer; the final choice is a maintainer merge-risk decision rather than a code defect for automation to repair.

options.title: Adopt this PR as canonical
options.body: Use this PR because it preserves explicit/all-mode reply behavior while fixing implicit single-use chunk fanout across text, media, voice, and component paths.

options.title: Choose another open PR
options.body: Pick an alternative only if maintainers prefer its implementation shape and are ready to handle the compatibility gaps this PR explicitly avoids.

options.title: Pause for broader reply policy work
options.body: Defer landing if maintainers want to change explicit payload reply semantics in core rather than fixing only implicit Discord chunk fanout here.
